{{Top|leg}}
An '''Imperial Capacitor-style garrison''' was a type of garrison used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. One such garrison was built on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. It was one of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] primary targets on Sullust.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
